hints: Reproduce it and watch closely: does the loaf's card show a photo of another product, or does another product show one of its own photos? Open the React DevTools and look at the state of the cards before and after sorting.
Which photo is on show is state inside each card component. When a list is rendered again in another order, React has to decide which old component matches which new item. What does it use to decide?

Look at the `key` of the list items in `client/src/components/ProductGrid.tsx`. A key that is the position in the list tells React "the first card is still the first card", whatever product is now in it.
